_schema.domain: lowercase apex domain (no scheme, no path, no www)
_schema.tier: 1 = wire/papers of record / professional editorial, 2 = beat/advocacy outlets, 3 = blogs/social/uncurated
_schema.name: human-readable publisher name
_schema.stance: neutral | critical | supportive | industry | unknown — posture toward law-enforcement surveillance
_schema.last_reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD when tier/stance was last confirmed by a human
_schema.feed_url: (optional) RSS/Atom feed URL — scripts/discover_articles.py polls this and auto-queues items matching ALPR keywords

_handler_policy.tier_1_clean: in-context read by Claude allowed (one-shot, scanner-clean only)
